items.summary: Legal disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; keep private. Woot documentation confirms API access but not commercial redistribution, storage, historical derivatives, public display, caching, alerts, affiliate, or advertising rights; public terms restrict product-listing use. The four launch-readiness legal tasks remain open. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, and owner gates are also blocked. Ordinary reversible fleet growth may continue where existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, rights, platform-policy, and rollback boundaries are preserved. Human counsel is required before any rights outreach, public data use, affiliate or advertising use, or launch-gate change.

Continue read-only SearchWoot evidence capture without changing production. Produce one dated bundle from backend/api/main.py, backend/services/fetcher.py, config.yml, deployed consent behavior, and GA4 configuration showing data flow, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, log fields, vendor processing, and incident/request handling. Do not send outreach or enable tracking.

Maintain the existing private-launch and security-sensitive release gates. No security task is closed: fleet-doctor and operations sweeps have no results, and authentication, secrets, isolation, release controls, dependencies, monitoring, incident readiness, and disclosure readiness remain unevidenced.
